submit.command:
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --account=jhpce
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:l40s:1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10
#SBATCH --mem=96G
#SBATCH --time=1-00:00:00
#SBATCH --signal=B:TERM@300
#SBATCH --no-requeue
set -euo pipefail
SCR="/fastscratch/myscratch/$USER/wcd"
JOBDIR="$SCR/prod/job_${SLURM_JOB_ID}"
mkdir -p "$JOBDIR"
git clone -q --no-checkout "$PWD/wcd.bundle" "$JOBDIR/repo"
git -C "$JOBDIR/repo" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout -q 0a872805e855a52deffad3297a6fec8c199eeece
rc=0
bash "$JOBDIR/repo/cluster/jhpce/prod_fit_job.sh" --expected-sha 0a872805e855a52deffad3297a6fec8c199eeece --stage fillers_x1_x13 --tags-file cluster/jhpce/tags/fillers_x1_x13_jobB.tags --tags-sha256 8d5d4b07c0f34f92a485a1e10d5ea26a9553b74f0bbfc87986946870fa83fce1 --manifest manifests/paper_manifest_stock_pilot_u5_b10.tsv --manifest-sha256 c0244ea4fd76ea05628060c69034d8947e5e4b338cb5e9952de166614a416afb --experiments 'X1 X13' --tasks 'lung pancreas sim2' --fit-lanes 8 --fit-timeout-s 7200 --max-attempts 2 --guard-margin-s 2700 || rc=$?
for f in "$JOBDIR/logs/job_summary.json" "$JOBDIR/harvest.json"; do [ ! -f "$f" ] || cp "$f" .; done   # KB-sized; the harvest stays on fastscratch
ls -l .
exit "$rc"
submit.intent: JHPCE gpu/jhpce 1x L40S (gpu:l40s:1), 10 CPU 96G, wall 1-00:00:00: production fits jobB (150 rows: X1 none/scvi_adv + X13 scanvi/sysvi; lung pancreas sim2) at 0a872805e8, fit only, harvest on fastscratch
